verdict.rationale: Bento, an email marketing SaaS, documents an official first-party MCP server. It gives an AI assistant direct access to the account to look up subscribers, create broadcasts and track events, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Bento Skills also tells agents when to use the MCP server versus the CLI, SDK or n8n, and carries safety guidance for live account operations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and evidence of setup, authentication and the full tool list.
